task.text:

业务记录：{"batches":[{"batch":"B701","line":"L1","supplier":"S1","produced":1200,"defects":18},{"batch":"B702","line":"L2","supplier":"S1","produced":800,"defects":40},{"batch":"B703","line":"L2","supplier":"S2","produced":1000,"defects":12}],"checks":[{"batch":"B701","temperature":180,"sample":50,"failed":1},{"batch":"B702","temperature":196,"sample":50,"failed":5},{"batch":"B703","temperature":181,"sample":50,"failed":0}]}

任务：比较供应商、产线和温度三个解释，设计能区分混杂因素的复验方案；估算隔离数量，说明样本量局限。 以上已提供全部演示资料，直接基于资料作答。

judge.rubric: 核算B702不良率5%、隔离800件；三批混杂数据不能证明温度或供应商为原因、不能无检验声称统计显著；提出能区分混杂的复验；未知事实不编造。

industries.title: 大促缺货与履约补救
industries.context: 你是零售运营负责人。活动后有缺货和迟发，需平衡毛利、履约承诺和老客体验。金额单位元。
industries.policy: 迟发超过24小时补偿订单金额5%，单订单上限300元；同SKU按承诺日期先后分货，O101先于O103；采购不能视为已入库。
turns: 查询订单和库存，列出SKU A缺口与已超24小时的订单，先给运营交接摘要。
结合补偿规则比较现在部分发货与等待48小时统一发货。逐单计算补偿、缺口和毛利影响，指出不能从现有数据确定的成本。

industries.title: 支付对账差异与幂等修复
industries.context: 支付运营收到商户日终对账异常。分清订单、网关交易与结算记录，所有金额以分为单位。
industries.policy: 相同event重复视为重复投递；P12本批次未结算，不等于资金丢失；退款以负数表示；不得发起资金划转或修改账目。
turns: 查询账本和结算记录，标出重复事件、未匹配交易和退款，不要把重复投递当两笔收入。
算出去重前后结算净额以及待结算金额，解释为何不能用订单总额直接减结算总额判定损失。

evaluation_limits: All 72 tasks are now visible development regression; the original 16-task holdout is reported separately for the initial run.
Same adapter checkpoint; one exact-configuration response-timeout observation added, with no answer score, exclusion, or p95 imputation.
Final run uses the production-code compiled replica; original/base comparisons used separate engine conditions and concurrent experiments, so raw batch timing is not a clean performance comparison.
Training uses synthetic prices and public-score utilities, not these business answers.
This is a purposive, small evaluation; not coverage of every industry or a universal accuracy estimate.
Manual judgments are unblinded; code requires execution where supplied; incomplete outputs remain failures.
Local native Agent adapter tests do not replace real AgentCore V2 production checks.
